description: This file defines the FreeTDSManager class, a PHP class that extends MssqlManager to facilitate interaction with SQL Server databases via FreeTDS. The class specifies database capabilities, type mappings, and query handling tailored for the FreeTDS driver, and includes a validation method to check driver availability.

classes.name: FreeTDSManager
classes.description: A PHP class for managing SQL Server interactions via FreeTDS, extending the base MssqlManager class.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Overrides the parent query method to append N prefix to SQL statements and execute them.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the FreeTDS driver functions are available and if the environment supports FreeTDS.
